event: US retail sales, Tuesday 17 Nov 15:30 SAST. Then the Fed's October minutes, Wednesday 18 Nov 21:00 SAST. Fed Chair Warsh comments also due this week (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Drifting lower
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,866 at 07:35 SAST, down from a 3,886 open, after a failed push to about 3,901-3,906 and a low of 3,860 (xauad; exact high UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bad week behind
bullets.text: Gold fell about 4.7% last week, its biggest weekly drop since early June, from a 4,149 high to a 3,852 low (TradingKey, Kitco).

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year is near 5.15% and the dollar stays firm, which weighs on gold (Mitrade).

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: Markets price about 90% odds of a quarter-point Fed hike in December and about 10% for a half point (Rallies, TradingKey).

bullets.title: Fed sounds hawkish
bullets.text: Fed speakers say inflation is running too hot, and traders wait for Chair Warsh and Wednesday's minutes (Rallies).

bullets.title: Oil and Iran
bullets.text: Hormuz tensions keep Brent near 96 dollars, a risk that can spark sudden gold spikes (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Silver weaker too
bullets.text: Spot silver fell about 2.8% to 47.38, so the whole metals complex is under pressure (Rallies).
